cases.title: Combined domains

cases.title: Unsupported change
cases.request: Review this proposal. Keep unsupported changes explicit and do not certify them.
cases.expected_outcome: Unsupported description change forces acknowledgment/cancel; acknowledgment retains limited_review.

cases.title: Wrong hostname
cases.request: Review this uploaded proposal for the selected router.
cases.expected_outcome: Intake rejects mismatched hostname before model calls or review creation.

cases.title: Temporary comparison failure
cases.request: Review this proposal; recover once from a temporary tool failure and disclose unresolved limits.
cases.expected_outcome: One injected comparison failure, bounded recovery, actual successful comparison before report.

cases.title: Persistent comparison failure
cases.request: Review this proposal. If required tools remain unavailable, stop with unresolved work rather than inventing findings.
cases.expected_outcome: Repeated required comparison failure hands off; cancel closes unresolved; no approved artifact.

cases.title: Pending review after restart
cases.request: Review this proposal and prepare a report for human decision.
cases.expected_outcome: Restart at approval, reopen same ID/hash, approve saves exact report without rerunning completed investigation.

cases.title: Revision and rejection
cases.request: Review this proposal and prepare a conditional report; preserve limitations in every section.
cases.expected_outcome: Human revision updates affected sections and hash; subsequent rejection saves no approved artifact.
